notes.title: Tell Me Your Story - Update 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2][b] Hey! It's us again! 

We're here to let you know that we're taking your comments on the game into account and working not only on bugs but also on puzzles - everything to make your experience with the game better and better!

So... 1.0.2 for Tell Me Your Story is now live 📢 [/b][/h2]


[b]Patch 1.0.2 includes:

Level changes

Chapter 2 / Level 32
Simplifying the pattern for players to be arranged
Added edge to suggest the orientation of pattern placement

Chapter 3 / Level 42
Macarons now have markings and decorations
Increased readability of the visuals[/b]

[h2][b]
Enjoy the game! ❤️[/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415570/Tell_Me_Your_Story/

notes.title: Tell Me Your Story - Update 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2][b] Hey! We are happy to announce that the patch update 1.0.1 for Tell Me Your Story is now live 📢 [/b][/h2]



[b]Patch 1.0.1 includes:

Redesign of level 35
Fixed bug that was skipping the levels
Fixed bug where level's stickers vanished after finishing a stage[/b]


[b]
Enjoy the game! ❤️[/b]
